verdicts.explanation: The paper states the optimum of about 6.5×10⁻⁵ S/cm at 1.0–1.1 mol/kg, obtained by Arrhenius extrapolation to 353 K from MD, so the value, unit, 80 °C temperature and computational origin are right. Secondary fields are null, and the activation energies are in kcal/mol, so leaving them null is correct.

The paper states that σ at T = 300 K has a maximum of 1.3×10⁻⁶ S/cm for the LiPF6/PPC SPE, an extrapolated MD result from this work, so the value, unit, 300 K (26.85 °C) and computational origin are right. The concentration is not stated for this value, which the record already notes, and the secondary fields are null as they should be.
